ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity (dark) pixels comprising approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light) pixels localized to linear scars and edge highlights; estimated macro-ratio of 0.18:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) mapping across the mid-to-distal regions of the right lobe; irregular light mottling clusters concentrated at the distal tips; solid low-intensity base across the central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 70 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3 to 10 pixels, creating a jagged boundary profile isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a strong convex mathematical curve; trailing edges follow a generally linear trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips with localized micro-concavities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (<5px diameter) detected primarily on the lower-central region of the left lobe and distal edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, parallel, diagonally-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) breaking the base pigmentation mapping; most prominent on the right lobe extending from mid-fluke to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-linear rake marks (likely cetacean-induced) across both lobes; irregular tissue loss/notching on the distal margins of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The parallel nature and high density of the linear abrasions on the right lobe create a unique 'raked' texture not present in standard pigmentation models.
